title: "POSSIBLE CAUSES, BASES, OR ORIGINS OF SPECULATIVE ILLUSIONS" — Generated By An Aleatory Method

lists.name: Possible causes, bases, or origins of speculative illusions
lists.of: speculative illusion and its possible cause
items: Could absolute oblivion (that we ever truly forget anything) : be an illusion caused by : imperfections or costs of common sense?
Could the impotence of the individual : be an illusion caused by : misinformation?
Could the expansion of universe : be an illusion caused by : interference?
Could lifeless matter : be an illusion caused by : neurosis, psychosis, or other forms of irrationality?
Could exceptionless laws : be an illusion caused by : camouflage, hiding, or environmental mimicry or assimilation?
Could identical things : be an illusion caused by : lack of a transcendent (to suggest imperfection, finitude, etc) or a companion?
Could the energy-matter dichotomy : be an illusion caused by : misconstrual of function from appearance or mis-supposition of appearance from function?
Could human diversity : be an illusion caused by : static or dynamic configurations?
Could unanalyzable things : be an illusion caused by : lack of self-criticism, self-ignorance, or lack of criticism in general?
Could free will : be an illusion caused by : ignorance (lack of information)?
Could human finitude : be an illusion caused by : misestimation (poor quantification)?
Could a finite cosmos : be an illusion caused by : persistence despite (or actually via) transformation (meta-continuity)?
Could openness or infinitude of the universe (of space, time, etc) : be an illusion caused by : "Pseudo-convergences" (e.g., in data series) or regressional fallacies?
Could necessity of precise mathematics (as opposed to only very approximate) : be an illusion caused by : insufficient criteria of illusoriness?
Could absolute size (or unique spatial order and hierarchy) : be an illusion caused by : unwillingness to doubt or to consider the possibility of illusion, or complacency?

Could that the universe has no center : be an illusion caused by : fallacious equation of partitude, rarity, singularity, etc with insignificance (e.g., discounting of what is small, exaggeration of the importance of what is large; erroneous proportionality)?
Could delomorphous being : be an illusion caused by : unconstrained imagination or 'pseudo-perception' (spurious acts of perception that are assumed to have occurred but that in fact did not occur)?
Could complexity : be an illusion caused by : arbitrary decisions?
Could time (or a unique temporal order and hierarchy) : be an illusion caused by : continuity?
Could psychic singularity (as opposed to polypsychism) : be an illusion caused by : complexity?
Could chance (absolute randomness) : be an illusion caused by : anomalousness?
Could the uniqueness of physical reality (continuity of world or uniqueness of causal regularity) : be an illusion caused by : prejudices?
Could ultimate elements : be an illusion caused by : hierarchy (multiplicity of confusing and interfering levels)?
Could finite beauty : be an illusion caused by : unfamiliarity or novelty that confuses?
Could all forms of absolute continuity (of rotation, structure, energy, etc) : be an illusion caused by : anomalousness?
Could the stability or safety of sun : be an illusion caused by ambiguity, indeterminacy, or myriontology?
Could eternal matter : be an illusion caused by : misattribution?
Could the absolute independence of events (of any physical events in the cosmos) : be an illusion caused by : wanton desire?
Could transcendental or eternal ideas : be an illusion caused by : logical fallacies or misapplication of general principles?
Could absolutely fundamental things : be an illusion caused by : homology of perceptual categories?
Could "physical separability" : be an illusion caused by : reification or hypostatization?

notes: The photograph cuts off the chart after the beginning of item 33. Item 14 is obscured and omitted.
